head: b5966488f76d43857ccf0a2ca842fba7e2fda58f

source.ref: b5966488f76d (fix(cli): write ocra serve's state file in one rename), no later fix to the changed code

rationale: A small fix with no known issue in the changed code: ocra serve's state file is written through the shared atomic private-file write instead of a direct write, so a client polling for it never reads it half written. The shared write creates the directory with the same mode the removed mkdir used and the file with 0600, so nothing else changes.

learnings.name: private-file-writes
learnings.title: Private files are synced before the rename, and renames retried on Windows
learnings.body: Session files renamed into place without an fsync could be left empty by a crash. The temporary file is synced before the rename, and on Windows a rename that fails with EPERM, EBUSY or EACCES is tried again for about a second.

learnings.name: serve-limit-race
learnings.title: Count reviews still starting against the serve limit
learnings.body: Two requests at once both passed the limit check before either run had a name, so ocra serve could run more reviews than it allows. A review counts against the limit from the moment it is accepted.
